program.ran_from: a fresh copy of the four modules outside the repository, held byte for byte to the retained copy on every invocation

environment.cap_rule: a run starts only if the recorded CPU, the worst case of every run still going and its own stay within the cap; each run's worst case is its timeout, held by RLIMIT_CPU and the wall timer
